clarification: N806 supplies the actual differential cubic/cross-Hessian compensation needed for fixed contact-direction strong-L4 loss control and contact-plane Jensen. The reduced denominator h* can be arbitrarily smaller than h on bounded actual compatible H>0 fields; concentration permits escaping optimizers. Earlier exact constructions and status remain intact.

issue: A new attempted deterministic-to-randomized bump lower-bound transfer fails; R16 is unchanged.
clarification: The FJ root Gaussian-mixture calculation gives one-query TV O(d^-1/4) on a conservative Lipschitz independent-coordinate narrow-bump family with nonvanishing mean. The FJ worker withdrew its attempted randomized extension before freezing. This corrects that new attempt, not a published N687 theorem; neither R16 nor the general polylogarithmic gate is validated/refuted. The generic direct proxy sampler is a sqrt(d)/epsilon baseline with full-vector reading cost.
